paper_title: Search for galactic axions with a traveling wave parametric amplifier
coupling_convention: |g_agammagamma| in GeV^-1, 90% single-sided C.L. upper limit as plotted on y-axis
notes: QUAX-a-gamma haloscope search with a traveling wave parametric amplifier at ~10.353 GHz. Sets 90% single-sided CL power-constrained upper limits on |g_agamma| over the axion mass range 42.8178-42.8190 ueV (4.28178e-5 to 4.28190e-5 eV). The paper states a minimum limit g < 2.05e-14 GeV^-1 (1.2x the KSVZ benchmark). Detailed per-bin limits are shown only in Figure 7 (blue bars, roughly 2e-14 to ~1e-13 with gaps between tuning steps); no numerical table is provided, so the two emitted points span the stated mass range at the best (minimum) limit value from the text.
